message: Hub setup now promotes the same process to the Project Hub when Graph and Wiki are ready; the commit/restart screen is no longer the terminal UI.

Overview no longer uses a first-visit welcome hero. Context is a compact everyday doorway above the atlas that opens Context only when the Wiki index is fresh and otherwise points to Health; Setup keeps the welcome.

Hub first-run onboarding is checkout-local (.mex/local/hub-onboarding.json through /api/v1/settings/onboarding), never replaces the setup wizard, and can be replayed from Settings. Browser storage would reset on every launch because the Hub binds a new loopback port.
